teach.one_line: Core AI startups are attracting unusually large funding rounds.
teach.like: Like a gold rush: the biggest checks go to the people digging closest to the vein.
teach.why: Capital is chasing frontier AI, where technical gains and platform control can still create outsized returns.
teach.remember: Frontier AI gets the jumbo checks.
